text: _Left than archangel ruin'd, and the exact_ Of _Ivyself._

parsed.faithful: Left than archangel ruin'd, and the exact Of Ivyself. Left than archangel ruin'd, and the excess Of glory obfeur'd.———
parsed.modern: Left than archangel ruined, and the exact Of Ivyself. Left than archangel ruined, and the excess Of glory obscured.———
